testo:
J’ai passé une nuit chez Alessandro avant mon vol retour. J’ai été très bien accueillie malgré un malentendu sur mon heure d’arrivée... Tout est parfait,  la communication excellente,  la chambre spacieuse, la literie super confortable  et les consignes précises. 

La côte depuis l’arrêt de bus est un peu raide si vous traînez votre valise mais rien d'insurmontable.  Pour rejoindre l'aéroport en bus,  il faut prendre une correspondance donc ça n’est pas hyper pratique ni rapide mais là encore,  rien d'insurmontable.
Peaceful place exactly as pictures. Host was kind enough to drop me to airport.

Alessandro ist ein sehr netter, zuvorkommender und humorvoller Gastgeber. Das Zimmer und Bad in einwandfreiem Zustand, tolles Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis! Das Frühstück, mit selbstgebackenem Brot und Muffins war sehr liebevoll angerichtet und besonders. Ich hab mich sehr wohl gefühlt.
Ambiente pulito e host super disponibile
Todo genial, habitación cómoda con baño privado en buena ubicación
丰盛早餐，步行可至公交，alessandro人也很好
Everything was fine, nice place to be.
Volvería Alessandro es un anfitrión impecable y excelente ser humano

Wunderschönes gepflegtes Zimmer in ruhiger Lage. Perfekt für einen kurzen Aufenthalt zwischen Flughafen Süd und Hafen. Alessandro ist sehr sympathisch, zuverlässig und gastfreundlich. Er hat mich vom Flughafen abgeholt und mich bestens betreut. Das Frühstück war überwältigend und mit Liebe zubereitet. Ich kann Alessandros Unterkunft auf jeden Fall empfehlen.

We had a wonderful stay with our host Alessandro. He gave us many great recommendations, especially for local restaurants—the one we tried was truly excellent. 

He also guided us on how to get to his place and helped us find the apartment easily. Once there, he explained everything clearly.

 The room was extremely comfortable, we had our own bathroom, access to a pool with a beautiful view of the mountains. It was all very pleasant.

We also enjoyed a lovely breakfast the next morning, and overall, everything was perfect.  

we recommend !
Anfitrión muy amable, muy bueno el desayuno. volveré otra vez.

The place is very nice and clean. Everything was exactly like in the offer. Alessandro is a very helpful and communicative host. The communication before and during the stay was very smooth. He also gave us many pointers regarding visiting the island. Thank you!
miejsce godne polecenia,  właściciel bardzo pomocny
Dormito bene accoglienza ottima

Alessandro fue muy muy amable, cercano, cordial, pendiente de cada detalle, la habitación muy ordenada y limpia, con todo lo que se necesita, al igual que el baño, los desayunos muy variados y cuidado con mucho detalle. gracias
Vše bylo ok. Alessandro výborně komunikuje anglicky.

we had a private bathroom connected to the bedroom, loved it! It was very comfortable. Alessandro also prepared the breakfast for us and it was very well done. He was also very friendly and calm. We would definitely come back.
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very friendly and communication was easy. Would happily stay again.

I had a very good stay at Alessandro's. The place was nice and clean, and easily reachable by bus (+ walk). Alessandro was very communicative and proactive. He gave me clear instructions and was available to help with whatever I needed.
Eine schöne Unterkunft, perfekt für einen kurzen Aufenthalt. Ich habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt und das Frühstück war spitze 👏

We stayed for one night and it was great. Alessandro picked us up from the airport for a fair price and brought us home. 
He showed us our room (important it’s his flat, so he made clear what we are allowed to use and what not). Afterwards he offered us a ride towards the city.
Even though we left early in the morning, he prepared us breakfast with delicious homemade bread.

Great for a short stay.
Everything was really very good! Very responsive and friendly host

Alessandro is a nice guy. The place is a room in his apartment with a private bathroom. Simple but fine. Alessandro was quiet and respectful. He prepared us a nice breakfast, which was unexpected. Cereals, yogurt, fruit, home made bread and a nice coffee. He also gave us a great restaurant recommendation.
All in all it was great for a stopover after our flight arrived quite late.

Après un accueil plutôt " administratif" , nous avons découvert l'appartement de notre hôte qui correspondait parfaitement à nos attentes, et au descriptif. nous n'avons donc été nullement surpris du règlement intérieur et des zones privées d'Alessandro. La chambre et sa salle de bain attenante,( vaste , un vrai plus)  étaient très propres. Literie de grande qualité et un petit réfrigérateur privé bien utile.. Endroit très calme à quelques minutes de la mer et à proximité de restaurants très sympas conseillés par notre hôte. Un petit déjeuner copieux nous est préparé, avec beaucoup de flexibilité de la part d'Alessandro. Bref, 3 nuits parfaites entre mer et montagne ( nous sommes là sur la route du Teide)
Merci à Alessandro
Allesandro był bardzo przyjazny i pomocny. Dzięki jego wskazówkom łatwo odnalazłem miejsce noclegu. Dziękuję za wszystko.
Заселился раньше положенного срока🤝

Very nice and Direct,

Lots of good recommendations.

Prywatne mieszkanie z wydzieloną częścią dla gości po przeciwnej stronie salonu niż część właściciela, dającą poczucie prywatności. Pokój i łazienka czyściutkie, pachnące. Dostępna lodówka, czajnik, suszarka do włosów,  ręczniki, kosmetyki. Śniadanie na słodko przygotowane przez gospodarza na wybraną godzinę. Okolica cicha, spokojna, z możliwością zaparkowania auta nieopodal. Właściciel bardzo precyzyjnie przedstawił wszystkie zasady dotyczące wynajmu i oferował porady dotyczące lokalnych atrakcji, restauracji itp.- warto skorzystać z jego wiedzy i podpytać, jeśli ma się jakieś wątpliwości. Bardzo pomocne było to, że odebrał nas z parkingu i pomógł trafić do mieszkania.
Alessandro es super atento, la limpieza del piso es increíble. La cama muy cómoda. Un sitio genial para descansar después de la playa. El desayuno muy completo!

We stayed at Alessandro’s place for one night and had a very pleasant experience. The room was very clean and looked exactly like in the photos. Everything was well prepared and comfortable.

There is also a small shop close to the house where you can buy water and snacks if needed, which was very convenient.

In the morning, Alessandro prepared breakfast for us, which was very kind and already included in the price. The accommodation was very affordable, so this was an especially nice surprise.

Thank you, Alessandro, for your hospitality – we definitely recommend this place!
Kedves Vendéglátó, hasznos tanácsokat kaptunk! Köszönjük
Allessandro ist ein sehr freundlicher und zuvorkommender Gastgeber.

Alessandro is an exceptional host. He gave us clear instructions about his rental, transportation, tours, important phone numbers and places that serve great local food. He made amazing breads and treats for breakfast, ensured we were okay and safe, and best of all, took us on an incredible day trip off-the-beaten track. We shared stories and great local food together. Would definitely recommend if you don't mind smaller space. Thank you Alessandro, it was a pleasure meeting you!

We had a wonderful stay. Alessandro is a very friendly, welcoming, and attentive host who made us feel comfortable from the very beginning. He was always happy to help and quick to respond to any questions. The location is quiet and peaceful, perfect for relaxing and enjoying some calm time away from the noise.
Breakfasts were served at a time that was convenient for us, which we really appreciated. They included muesli, nuts, fresh fruit, bread, butter, jam, yoghurts, and excellent natural coffee. Everything was fresh and delicious.
The accommodation was well looked after and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We truly appreciated the peaceful atmosphere, the great breakfasts, and Alessandro’s warm hospitality. Everything was perfect. We would definitely recommend this place and would happily stay here again

Alessandro oli loistava isäntä! Tuli vastaan parkkipaikalle, kertoi upean ravintolan. Aamiaisella ollut itseleivottu leipä oli loistavaa ja samalla saatiin jutella mukavia isännän kanssa. Huone oli erittäin siisti, kaapit ja laatikot tyhjinä vieraita varten, ja kaikessa näki, että vierasta olis todellakin ajateltu. Kylpyhuone oli tahraton ja mukavan iso. Olimme vain yhden yön, mutta olisimme viihtyneet pidempäänkin. Suosittelen lämpimästi!

The host picked us up at the airport for a very reasonable price, a service he offers his guests. Alessandro is exceptionally patient and helpful. He waited for our delayed flight, answered our numerous questions, gave us tips on late night eating places and served a substantial breakfast. His homemade bread was a delight. Space is limited, but as advertised. Would recommend.

Mooie, schone kamer met ruime badkamer en heerlijk ontbijt, in het appartement van Alessandro. We kregen duidelijke instructies en veel tips om het maximale te halen uit ons kort verblijf in het zuiden van Tenerife. Zelfgebakken brood bij het uitvoerig ontbijt maakte het af. Prijs-kwaliteit een aanrader!

Alles war genauso wie beschrieben.  Perfekt für einen kurzen Aufenthalt.
Etwas abgelegen, aber mit dem Auto gut erreichbar.

Alessandro var super god til at kommunikere. Og desuden sjov. Dejligt at have sit eget badeværelse. Skøn morgenmad.
Fint boligkompleks.
Nemt at komme til Los Cristianos, når man har fundet stoppestedet.
非常舒适的公寓，感谢Alessandro的招待！这是一个非常适合在南部游玩时选择的住处，干净漂亮，有室外停车场，公寓群本身也很漂亮。早上还有便捷的早餐提供，对于短途旅行非常友好。十分感谢Alessandro推荐的海鲜市场，我们吃到了非常美味、正宗的当地海鲜，几乎都是本地人！

Great place, and very friendly host. especially beautiful and spacious bathroom. all toiletries are provided. comfortable bed for my back. great Italian breakfast, lots of everything and everything sweet. thanks Alessandro for the delicious bread made by the host himself, it is unique!

For me a stay at Alessandros place is the embodiment of AirBnB. 
A local, super helpful host and a nice room :)
Privaatne tuba vannitoaga ,kõik olemas, puhas. Alessandro pakkus ka hommikusööki. Jäime väga rahule.

La chambre-salle de bain était confortable , propre et bien située en dehors du centre de Tenerife mais tout proche en voiture. 
Par contre, nous ne nous attendions pas à cette disposition de l’appartement. La chambre louée est partie intégrante du lieu de vie de l’hôte. Seule une simple porte nous sépare du salon-cuisine occupé par l’hôte. 
L’entrée est partagée et se fait directement dans le lieu de vie.
Alessandro est accueillant et sympathique, et le rapport qualité prix est très intéressant. Néanmoins, personnellement nous préférons davantage d’intimité.
Un 10, como estar tú propia casa

Very convenient place close to the ferry port, yet reasonably quiet. Good access to Teide as well as the highway. Had a good chat with Alessandro and learned some behind the scenes fact of the local daily life. Very interesting! The private bathroom is actually quite large and we'll equipped.

A remarkable budget option tucked away in the hills of Chayofa. Ideal for a solo traveller thanks to its smart location and compact setup. For two people, however, the space felt tight—there was barely enough room to open two suitcases at once.

That said, we really valued the peace and quiet of the neighbourhood, Alessandro’s prompt and friendly communication, and the generous, delicious breakfast served each morning. While access to a kitchen or washer would have been nice, we were aware of this limitation at the time of booking.

The location is practical, with plenty of parking and easy access to buses, making it convenient despite the tranquil setting.

For the price and the fact that breakfast is included i think it’s totally worth it. The room is nice and clean and the best part is the private bathroom. You can forget that you are in someone’s house this way, feels like a hotel. I would go back there☺️.
Idem à mon premier séjour en début de semaine

Sans être présent car retenu par son travail, Alessandro a été très réactif et très à l'écoute de mes demandes. La communication s'est faite très facilement et tout correspondait au descriptif. 
Le rapport qualité-prix était parfait.
Alessandro est très réactif, nous avions un problème de téléphone portable et Alessandro a été patient. Il nous a communiqué un bon restaurant.
L’endroit  est accueillant et confortable. Alessandro, que je remercie, est de bons conseils, je recommande !

Je suis restée 2 nuits chez Alessandro. L'endroit est calme, situé dans un environnement paisible, il convient au repos et bien relié au réseau de bus. J'ai eu une très jolie chambre 😊 avec un grand placard pour ranger mes affaires. La salle de bain privative, attenante est très propre et moderne, un atout important.

Alessandro m'a conseillé un bon restaurant à Los Cristianos, el Cine. En bord de plage, mais un peu retiré,  je ne serais pas allée sans sa recommandation. Merci Alessandro !

superbe belle chambre très reposante 
Alessandro est très bien et vous met très alaise.
petit dej top et j'ai même séjourné deux fois de suite dans cette chambre.

C'est un excellent lieu pour se reposer.
Hôte discret et super sympa.
chambre propre avec un beau confort tout été très bien.
il faut aussi savoir que c'est accessible rapidement en bus et ca reste un logement très calme loin de l'agitation touristique donc très calme et paisible.
La piscine est super bien aussi.
ce logement a répondu à mes besoin
Alessandro nous prépare un généreux petit déjeuner c'est vraiment cool.
salle de privée franchement une bonne adresse.
We loved our stay at Alessandro's place. Not only was it exactly as described, he was also a very helpful, thoughtfull and available host. We had an amazing time and strongly recommend.

Convenient location with less than 10 mins’ drive to Siam park/mall, and the beach. Clean and cozy place with beautiful surroundings. Alessandro was a nice host and prepared a great breakfast for us. Recommended.
Excellent, kind service. Amazing breakfast.

Alessandro was a helpful host, huge choice for breakfast and lovely room. However, arriving by bus I could not see any clear instructions as to the whereabouts of the apartment once I arrived on the road. Once I called him  he arrived shortly after to take me to the complex.

O Alessandro foi sempre muito prestável. Partilhou connosco uma lista de restaurantes óptimos! A casa estava bastante limpa e organizado. O quarto é espaçoso e a casa de banho também. Recomendamos 100%
Le logement correspondait aux photos et aux commentaires précédents. Alessandro nous a bien conseillé sur quoi faire aux alentours, et nous avons mangé dans un bon restaurant. je recommande

Tive uma estadia excelente! O lugar é muito agradável, limpo e exatamente como descrito no anúncio. A localização é de fácil acesso, o que facilitou bastante nossos passeios pela região. O anfitrião, Alessandro, foi extremamente atencioso e simpático durante toda a estadia. Todos os dias ele preparava um café da manhã delicioso, o que tornou a experiência ainda mais especial. Recomendo com certeza e voltaria sem pensar duas vezes!

Una gran comunicación,buena zona,limpieza.
Muy amable ,educado y flexible.
Muchas gracias ,una gran experiencia!
Le séjour chez Alessandro était très agréable et ses conseils variés appréciables : )
L’hôte a été très accueillant et serviable en nous donnant des adresses . Il a aussi été flexible sur l’horaire d’arrivé . Le petit déjeuner été top . Je recommande
È stato tutto molto bello, posizione ottima, stanza molto pulita, zona tranquilla

Alessandro hat uns direkt vom Parkplatz abgeholt und in die Unterkunft begleitet.
Das Zimmer war so wie auf den Fotos gezeigt mit eigenem Badezimmer direkt nebenan. Wir haben nur eine Nacht verbracht und dafür war es prima. Zu zweit für mehrere Nächte gibt es direkt im Schlafzimmer keine Sitzmöglichkeiten, doch wir haben noch im Restaurant nebenan gesessen und sind dann direkt schlafen gegangen.
Alessandro ist sehr nett und hat uns ein Frühstück bereitet zu der Uhrzeit wie wir es wünschten. Er spricht Spanisch, Italienisch und auch Englisch.
Logistisch eine sehr gute Lage, da nah zur Fähre und auch nicht weit zum Flughafen Süd. natürlich auch toll für Ausflüge.
Wir kommen gerne wieder.
El anfitrión fue muy flexible con el horario y muy amable. El lugar es fácil de localizar y acceder y cuenta con aparcamiento.

The room was really nice with a private bathroom. The common areas (which are shared with the owner of the house) are also nice. We appreciated the homemade breakfast he prepared for us! The location is good, but a car is needed.
Estuve sólo una noche, todo estuvo genial y Alessandro es el perfecto anfitrión, atento y amable.

La chambre avec salle de bains privée se situe dans l'appartement d'Alessandro, c'est un BnB à l'ancienne où l'hôte vous accueille chez lui, vous prépare le petit déjeuner le matin, et n'hésite pas à vous guider en fonction de vos besoins (et il connaît très bien l'île). Il est possible de se garer dans le parking du lotissement meme s'il faut parfois être patient et tourner un peu pour trouver une place. Alessandro communique de manière précise pour venir nous accueillir et nous guider vers son appartement. La literie est   très satisfaisante, la salle de bain très fonctionnelle, et il y a même un petit frigo bien pratique dans la chambre. Le petit déjeuner était très complet (pain maison, différentes céréales, confitures, petits gâteaux...).

Hezké ubytování v krásném resortu s bazénem, parkování pokud nepřijedete úplně pozdě taky v pohodě, jedná se tedy o pokoj který je v apartmánu majitele, který tam také bydlí, což jsem si teda při objednávání nevšiml, ale vše v pořádku, je tam soukromá koupelna, kousek od letiště, 15 minut autem

We had a great stay at Alessandro’s place, even though it was just for one night. The apartment was homely, comfortable, and quiet. Perfect for getting some rest after our flight. Breakfast was delicious, and Alessandro was a fantastic host who shared great tips for exploring the island. Highly recommended!
Ottimo alloggio, a pochi minuti di auto dal centro principale Los Cristianos. Alessandro sempre disponibile.

Alessandro was very friendly. The place was really cozy. The complex is very beautiful. Surprisingly there was amazing area to chill next to swimming pool. Overall we were very happy. It’s worth to stay in Arona to explore local pretty neighbourhood.

Ich war nur für eine Nacht dort, hab mich aber gleich wohl gefühlt. Der Check-In hat super geklappt, das Zimmer war ruhig und angenehm. Von Alessandro habe ich noch Tipps für Ausflugsziele bekommen. Das Frühstück hat Alessandro liebevoll und zu meiner gewünschten Uhrzeit angerichtet. Ich würde das Zimmer auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.

Ich war eine Nacht in der Unterkunft bei Alessandro und habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Auch wenn es etwas außerhalb von Los Christianos ist, gibt es  ganz in der Nähe (2 min zu Fuß) einen Supermarkt und Restaurants. Alessandro hat mich sogar netterweise zur Fähre gebracht! Vielen Dank:)

Tuvimos una experiencia perfecta, Alessandro fue súper flexible y acogedor con una reserva de última hora. Nos ofreció un desayuno muy variado, y es en todo momento muy atento. Sin duda lo recomendamos al 100%

Lo consiglio sicuramente. Bella camera, complesso con piscina, Alessandro disponibile e prodigo di consigli e poi anche colazione da lui preparata a orario richiesto..decisamente piú del classico airbnb quindi 5 stelle meritate
Great host. Thanks for accommodating us at the last moment and the morning breakfast.
Una habitación muy silenciosa. Un magnífico desayuno. Y muy buen anfitrión. Muchas gracias Alessandro.

J'ai passé un excellent séjour chez Alessandro. La communication était parfaite avant et pendant le séjour, avec des instructions claires et précises pour l'arrivée. L'accueil a été chaleureux et attentionné. La chambre, située dans son appartement, était très propre et confortable. Alessandro est très organisé, ce qui rend l'expérience fluide et agréable. Le petit déjeuner inclus est un vrai plus, surtout pour un tarif aussi raisonnable. Je recommande vivement !
Alessandro is a very nice guy, lovely place to stay, would recommend
super début de séjour à Tenerife dans l'appartement d'Alessandro, hôte agréable et description conforme à l'annonce, merci

Alessandro is a nice, patient host & communicated very clearly. He gave us good recommendations as per our needs of a quiet place & great restaurants.

Also, he spread out an amazing breakfast spread for us & shared his home-made delicious bread.

If you are looking for something in budget around Los Cristianos & close to the ferry, highway & airport, this is a place for you!
punto strategico per visitare in particolare il sud di Tenerife.Tutto è andato bene ,valore aggiunto colazione preparata da Alessandro
We had a great stay at Alessandro's place, easy communication and everything as described.
It’s a really good place to spend some days in Tenerife!

Everything was fine, just as described. It could be shown as a "golden standard" of B&B. We got also some valuable and important information from our host on things to see and to do in Tenerife. We do recommend this house for everyone looking for a place to stay in southern part of the island.
Sehr guter Gastgeber. Allesandro kennt sich gut in der Umgebung aus. Das Frühstück ist grandios, alles in allem sehr empfehlenswert👍👍

Camera e bagno come da descrizione . Appartamento molto silenzioso nonostante si trovi all'interno di un complesso molto ampio .tutto il necessario presente in bagno .Pulizia impeccabile , buona e varia colazione dolce . posizione strategica per muoversi in varie direzioni sull'isola . Parcheggio disponibile senza particolari problemi . Consigliato

Logement propre, correspond aux photos dans une résidence calme avec petit déjeuner. 
C'était très bien, je recommande

Non potevamo trovare di meglio nei dintorni di Los cristianos! Vicinissimo a Los Cristianos e all'areoporto. Casa molto bellina e stanza tenuta benissimo. Alessandro super disponibile e gentile. Consiglio vivamente!
Nagyon kedves házigazda. Nagyon finom reggelit kaptunk. Alessandro kedves és segítőkész. Nagyon jó programokat ajánlott. Csodálatos szálláshely. Alig várjuk, hogy visszajöjjünk hozzá.
Alessandro was extremely helpful and attentive. Excellent breakfast and kettle and teapot in room an added unexpected bonus.

De accommodatie ligt in een gesloten complex met rust en ruimte. De host was zeer communicatief via berichten, stond ons ook op te wachten bij aankomst aan het complex. Hij was zeer proactief in functie van de verschillende uitstappen die we dagelijks gepland hadden (hebben jullie tickets, zeker dat het open is, zou je niet beter een andere dag gaan). De slaapkamer bevat over een eigen badkamer en in de kast staat een koelkastje en microgolfoven voor als je zelf even wil iets aankopen/klaarmaken. Dat hebben wij niet gedaan. Ontbijt werd elke morgen klaar gezet, basic maar ruim voldoende, vooral het zelf gebakken brood en de granola waren superlekker. Wil je iets meer kun je zelf aanvullen. 
Wij waren er een weekje, een auto is wel een must aangezien het toch net iets te ver is van de populaire stranden of grotere supermarkt. 
Voor ons was het de perfecte uitvalsbasis voor onze dagelijkse trips met de rust die we 's avonds konden opzoeken.
Alessandro è stato molto gentile e disponibile, la camera accogliente e pulita, la colazione molto buona.
Ačiū už ramią ir jaukią viešnagę bei pusryčius ❤️
Ottima posizione e qualità/prezzo

Mon séjour ne fût que de deux nuits et  j'ai vraiment tout apprécié, la chambre avec tous les équipements, le lit très confortable, la salles de bain spacieuse, la propreté je note 10/10 et les petites attentions comme le café, le thé, sucre, petits chocolats, les produits de douche comme à l'hôtel. Nuits paisibles, zéro bruit et Alessandro, tellement discret, attentionné et serviable. Le petit plus est la proximité de l'aéroport 15 minutes environ et il peut vous proposer de vous emmener pour quelques euros, moins cher qu'un taxi. Si vous recherchez un endroit calme et agréable, je ne peux que recommander le logement de Alessandro.  Belle expérience pour moi.

Alessandro is een geweldige host. Attent en behulpzaam. Geeft fijne tips voor wat er in de omgeving te doen is, aangepast op je eigen interesses. Alle ruimtes waren ontzettend netjes en heel erg schoon. Heerlijk rustig gelegen in een afgesloten appartementencomplex. Wij hebben er maar 1 nacht geslapen maar zouden zeker terugkomen.

Ottima zona per chi viaggia in macchina. 
La stanza e il bagno corrispondono alle foto. 
Orario per la colazione flessibile.
Accesso alla stanza da uno spazio condiviso.
Host sempre disponibile per informazioni sull'isola, ci ha sempre dato ottimi consigli.
Alessandro war ein guter Gastgeber, kann es nur weiterempfehlen vor allem, wenn man alleine ist und nur ein Ort zum schlafen braucht und viel unterwegs ist. 👍🏝️

Top bloke who was very welcoming especially as it was my firstvair bnb experience out of my comfort zone.  

Great experience!!

Peace and love brother

Alessandro is a wonderful, amazing host! He was out the time of our arrival but he let us very clear instructions, so it was easy to reach his place and go inside. The room had  all that we needed and even more,  it was very clean and comfortable. The breakfast was really tasty, with homemade bread.  Also he gave us a lot of hints and tips about the interesting things to do and to see during our short stay,that makes our trip unforgettable. We highly recommend this place and definitely will be back)

Alessandro è un ospite discreto, puntuale e preciso! È molto disponibile e preparato nel dare consigli utili sull'isola, che conosce molto bene, e sa farti scoprire i posti più belli, evitando le fregature per turisti.
Devo aggiungere che l'alloggio è pulito, ordinato, comodo, e il servizio di colazione è davvero ottimo. Inoltre la zona è stupenda e tranquilla, ed è garantito passare un soggiorno rilassante!
Per il prezzo è sicuramente l'alloggio migliore in rapporto servizi-prezzo, avendo pure a disposizione la piscina del residence!

- Highly recommended
- I stayed for a month and really enjoyed my stay (I will definitely come back)
- Very clean, quiet and spacious room + bathroom
- All outdoor areas and pool clean and well maintained
- A big bonus is the breakfast

Alessandro offers a nice room with fridge and private bathroom. It's located at ~10 mins by car and ~ 10-15 mins (+10 mins walking) by local public buses (guaguas). Use Line 418 (direction : Valle San Lorenzo) or Line 480 (direction : Arona) at Estacion de Guaguas de Los Cristianos, alight at the "Chayofa" stop, be super careful when crossing the TF-38 road and let your navigation app guide you toward it's place. Alessandro and his french partner were really hospitable and the breakfast they serve was copious : perfect to start a sweet sightseeing/hiking day in Tenerife. This BnB's location is perfect if you want to visit The Teide : use the "Parque Las Águilas" bus stop and take bus Line 342 (direction : El Teide - Portillo), every day at ~09:35. La habitación muy equipada, tal cual las fotos y los comentarios, el desayuno muy variado, Alessandro una persona muy atenta, muy buena comunicación en todo momento, y destacar que nos ayudo bastante en nuestro desplazamiento hacia el aeropuerto haciendo uso de su vehículo para llevarnos. Muchas gracias

The room is just as on the photos and breakfast is wonderful with lots of choice.
Alessandro is a great host, very responsive and his passion for the island really shines through. He is very knowledgeable and will give you tips on what to do and where to go or even take you there himself!

the room Alessandro offers is very comfortable and clean, with private bathroom.
it's located one bus stop from Los Cristianos main station but you will not be able to walk there. if you have a car the room is perfect for you. thanks

The best place in Tenerife! Easy to find, great communication.

They also let me work on the balcony. Just brilliant! Everything is well done at this stay! 

Have fun booking it ☺️👍🏾

Very comfortable clean and friendly 
Fantastic views great pool close to lots of things, all the beaches etc plus close to teide, car handy but bus service decent

I had a great one-week stay at Alessandro's. Room and ensuite as described, sparkling clean and well-cared. Breakfast included a variety of options adapted to my personal taste. The room is located in a relaxed complex with swimming pool and view, easy parking, few minutes by car from beach and tourist attractions. Alessandro is welcoming and super nice, highly knowledgeable of the island, and sportish and cultural activities. He also well-informed me on the current covid safety measures to make my stay as comfortable as possible. Top choice!
Very friendly and communicative. Got a lot of useful advice about the island. Breakfast was great. 10/10
Very nice place, alex is excelent host. Highly recommend.

Very clean room and bathroom with lots of storage space. There is a range of food for breakfast. Alessandro has a wealth of knowledge about Tenerife, particularly the geography and history. If you don’t have transport the buses are fairly reliable and it’s worth buying a bus card
Ottimo servizio di bed and breakfast con  colazione abbondante  e varia , servita  puntualmente agli orari concordati .
Muy limpio y prolijo! Muy amable!
Great place and best communication. Location brilliant!
Accueil exceptionnel d'Alessandro qui prend le temps de nous détailler l'itinéraire et de nous accueillir avec son amie qui parle notre langue. Conseil et informations sur le quartier.
Clean, secure apartment, very helpful host & good variety of food for breakfast
Een aanrader voor wie het rustig wil hebben. Geen probleem om volgens Spaanse normen een vroeg ontbijt te krijgen.

We've stayed 6 days at Allesandro's place and it was very easy to get everywhere by bus. By 5min walking you're at the busstation and it's only 5min driving to the centre of Los Christianos. Every morning we got a nice breakfast. We had a very clean room and bathroom and the complex was also very nice! On the last day we took a trip trough Tenerife with Allesandro as our guide and it was amazing, he shows you the most beautiful places on the Island it's a must do !
Ottimo alloggio e ottima organizzazione ed ospitalità da parte di Alessandro
Très bon accueil, appartement partagé avec notre hôte. Agrémenté d'une belle terrasse.

Host eccezionale! Massima disponibilità in tutto! Appartamento situato in un bellissimo complesso residenziale a Chayofa in una zona sicura, tranquilla e vicinissima a tutto. Ottima posizione. La stanza con il bagno privato all'interno è davvero bella, ben curata, con armadi, mobili ed un piccolo frigo per le bevande. Tutto ECCELLENTE ma soprattutto Alessandro che mi ha aiutato e sopportato durante il soggiorno!
Great stay, welcoming host!
Excellent, clean and tidy en-suite accomodation with the breakfast included in the very quiet area of Chayofa - 10 min drive to Playa las Vistas
Très bon accueil d’Alessandro qui nous a préparé un petit déjeuner royal! L’appartement est agréable et calme et situé dans une zone résidentielle

Alessandro and is girlfriend are great and nice hosts, the room is clean with private bathroom and breakfast is appreciated! Only cons would be that the bedroom gives directly to the living room/kitchen so the privacy is limited for a couple. If it's not a problem for you, totally recommended!

I enjoyed my stay at Alessandro’s place very much! Good communication, airport pick-up, nice breakfast outside, beautiful place with swimming pool and the room was quite and very clean. Hardly recommend. Good connection to busses all over Tenerife.

Alessandro, avant même mon arrivée, m’avait envoyé les informations nécessaires pour rejoindre son logement. L’accueil était très bien surtout qu’a ma bonne surprise sa compagne était française, ce qui m’a permis d’avoir toutes les informations concernant Ténérife de façon très claire. Mon anglais est loin d’être bon (sans parler de mon espagnol) mais Alessandro a été patient pour m’indiquer les bons plans et m’a même proposer de m’emmener en rado pédestre. Ce fut d’ailleurs une super journée avec la découverte du nord du pays. Séjour très agréable à Ténérife. 
Je recommande cet hôte.
Très bon accueil d'Alessandro qui nous a préparé la chambre très rapidement. Un hôte fortement recommandé.

Potete apettarvi pulizia, precisione , massima disponibilità, cortesia e rapidità nelle risposte. Camera e bagni privati sufficientemente ampi e ben curati.
Camera con finestra in  appartamento silenzioso con terrazzo.

Très bon accueil . Allessandro est très disponible et n’hésite pas à faire des recherches pour nous indiquer les bons plans. Chambre très confortable, dans une résidence très calme. Petit déjeuner copieux. Très discret. Adresse à retenir.

Man muss Alessandro ein Kompliment machen, wie er es schafft, trotz seiner beruflichen Belastung, seinen Gästen ein gemütliches zu Hause zu bieten, ist bewundernswert. 
Jeder der einen unkomplizierten Auffenthalt sucht, ist hier richtig. Ohne Transportmittel, Auto oder Velo, am besten beides, ist es etwas kompliziert. Aber Mietwagen sind überall verfügbar. Dafür ist man in 10 Minuten in Los Cristianos und Richtung Teide schon in der Spur. Also, ich empfehle diese Unterkunft.

Alessandro is a very friendly and flexible host who also gave us a lot of recommendations for discovering the southwest of Tenerife. The breakfast was very tasty and substantial. Everything was clean and with a way description it was easy to find the BnB in Chayofa.
Chayofa is a nice and quiet village and you can reach a lot of places, attractions and the next supermarket/mall easily in less than 10 minutes by car.
Super Quartier für Leute, die es ruhig haben wollen.

Room was as advertised, very clean and had all I needed for my stay.
Alessandro was very helpful and polite and put me at ease.

L'alloggio si trova in una zona residenziale, ben collegata con le arterie principali, tanto da permetterti di raggiungere qualsiasi destinazione.  Alessandro si è dimostrato un ottimo ospite, ha preparato ogni giorno delle ottime colazioni, che ci permettevano di affrontare la giornata con la giusta energia. L'appartamento è veramente carino, silenzioso e confortevole.
Grazie alessandro.

Very helpful and kind host. He keeps the house super clean. Breakfast is like a King's feast :)
Pls note though that guests are not allowed to use kitchen and living room. I didnt have a problem with that but good to know.  

Note about location - The location is really great if u like peace and quiet and have a car to get around. If u don't have a car it's difficult. Buses are not very reliable and frequent. I ended up spending a lot on taxi. Although it's not too far to walk to main areas , it's connected only by highways so very difficult to walk.

But the location is gorgeous , you can see the ocean from the balcony, and it's green all around with gorgeous houses.

My dad enjoyed staying at Allessandros place. He is a great host, and the room was quiet and clean. Also the private bathroom was perfect. We can definately recommend his place. A car is recommendable to rent.
Clean and tidy room with private bathroom, breakfast and friendly host. Thanks!
Alessandro ist sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Das Zimmer ist super und ruhig mit eigenem Badezimmer, liegt aber abseits in einem Wohncomplex.

Tenerife is beautiful island where you want to came back, not only because the climate is comfortable yet also of the people that we met . We estimate this "bed and breakfast " very high and will recommend to stay in Alessandro,s house. Thanks a lot Alessandro and we hope to come back. Alessandro is hospitable, careful and just cool guy. Everything are comfortable for guests. Umanets Tetiana and Mykola ( January 2017, Kiev, Ukraine)
Alesandro was a great host and gave a lot of useful tips about the island. The room is very cozy and clean. There is quite a big parking in front of the building.

Excellent bed & breakfast near Los Cristianos. Alessandro as a very helpful host knows knows a lot about Tenerife and what to do. The room is clean as well as the (private) bathroom. Important to know, the location (Chayofa) is a bit far away from Los Cristianos and Playa de las Américas. A rental car is recommended though it is possible to reach other places with public transportation.

Altogether, defnitely recommended!
Super hôte, Alexandro a été très disponible pour nous donner des conseils. La chambre est parfaite avec sa salle de bain. La residence est jolie, et la piscine très agréable. Je recommande !!

Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt bei Alex. Wir kamen recht spät am Flughafen an und dank seinem Angebot und abzuholen, war die Ankunft super easy. Das Zimmer entspricht genau den Fotos und Beschreibungen. Also wirklich alles super und nur zu empfehlen!

Nos encanto el lugar, apartado de la zona  turística de Los Cristianos ,nos recibió muy amablemente, veníamos de viaje de otra isla El Hierro algo cansados, hicimos uso de la piscina de la comunidad , pasando una tarde muy agradable y relajados.Nos sentimos muy cómodos, dándonos bastante información de la isla, nos aconsejo otro lugar para cenar en Tajao un pueblo de pescadores, que comimos muy ricamente pescado fresco del día. Gracias Alessandro
Alessandro was very welcoming and the room was perfect, just as described. I would definitely recommend to anyone wanting to stay!

We spent a short night at Alessandro's place.
It's a really nice appartement. The room is very clean, and we had everything we need.
Alessandro helped us knowing what kind of things we could do around and though, we spent a really nive evening.
Everything was perfect. We feel like home

Alessandro ist ein sehr netter, und hat uns auch sehr nett empfangen. Er hat uns zahlreiche Tipps bzgl. Essen, Trinken usw. gegeben.
Das Zimmer ( und Wohnung generell) sehr sauber und ordentlich. Wir konnten uns auch nett mit ihm unterhalten. Ich empfehle ihn gerne weiter.

The room is very nice & clean. The bathroom is very spacious and well-equipped (hair dryer, toiletries, towels). The location is totally easy to reach and quite close to Los Cristianos. Alex is a very very nice and friendly host. He gave lots of recommendations on what to do, he can even be your tour guide & take u to cool places, e.g. We took a trekking trip to Masca with Alex and it was super cool!! He also dropped us off to the airport with his own car, super nice.

Alessandro was a great host, he was very helpful and privided me with all kinds of information about the area. The   room with spacious, private bathroom was imaculate and the quality bed provided a good night's sleep. For anyone looking for just a room, I can wholeheartedly recommend Alessandro's place.

The room is great:clean, beautiful and with private bathroom. 
The house is in a perfect position to reach every part of the island and is close to Los Cristianos, probably the best place to have fun in Tenerife.
Alessandro is a great host! He's very kind and helpful and he knows everything about the island, so you can ask him any suggest to live Tenerife at his best.
I strongly recommend!

Had a great experience with Alessandro from check-in to check out. Very pleasant, clean room with a great bathroom. He was also kind enough to drive me the airport at a reduced rate. Highly recommend.
A nice clean and tidy room with ensuite bathroom. We felt comfortable at Alessandro's place and he's a nice and friendly person. Thanks for having us stay!

Alessandro was very quick to reply and very kind - offering to pick us up at the airport and then waiting for an hour when our flight was delayed. The place was just as described - B&B in his flat - this was perfect for us, as a one night stay before we caught the ferry to La Gomera. Bed and bathroom was nice and clean. V convenient for the airport and Los Cristianos.

Alessandro was very prompt in replying to my request for booking. He assisted me in trying to find his place despite the taxi driver trying to trick me. His apartment complex is a peaceful compound. The room itself is beautiful and very clean. The place is not walking distance to the playas and shopping centres, but a short drive from it. Alessandro was kind enough to give me a lift to one of the playa on day 1 and also gave suggestions on where to eat. And if you are lucky that he is available, he can provide transfer to the airport at half the price of cabs! Would def recommend others to stay in Alex's B&B.

The building complex was easy to find and there are plenty of parking space outside. The neighborhood is really calm and quiet, and they are some good restaurants nearby. The apartment is really clean, and the bedroom felt like luxury; the bed was really comfortable and it has its own ensuite bathroom.
Alessandro is really friendly and gave me some great advice of things to see on Tenerife. Grazie Alessandro!

Alessandro est un hôte très agréable, attentionné, serviable tout en étant discret. Alessandro a répondu à toutes mes questions et a bien pris le temps de m'indiquer des endroits à ne pas rater en fonction de mes attentes (plages tranquilles, restaurant typique...).
Le logement est parfaitement tenu, propre, lumineux, calme, avec une jolie terrasse où on peut observer le coucher du soleil sur la mer. La literie est très bonne, et il y a une salle de bain privée ! 
La piscine de la résidence est grande et bien entretenue. 
Le WIFI est très bon. L'appartement est situé près d'une entrée de l'autoroute ce qui rend l'accès très facile. Il faut une voiture pour aller à la plage et à Los Christianos, mais garer la voiture près de la résidence est facile. J'ai vraiment apprécié mon séjour chez Alessandro.
